sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the primary practical objective of executing a systemic school 'Water Audit'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A water audit systematically measures the total daily water volume consumed against literal wastage across school tabs, pinpointing leaks to layout efficient conservation strategies.

questions.question_text: Explain why it is practically important to provide clean, well-ventilated shelter structures for farm animals. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Properly ventilated shelters protect farm animals from extreme weather conditions, reduce the spread of respiratory diseases, and ensure a comfortable environment for optimal growth and production.

questions.question_text: Describe the basic structural difference between hardwood and softwood materials used in carpentry projects. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Hardwood originates from broad-leaved, deciduous trees and offers higher density and durability, whereas softwood comes from evergreen conifers, making it lighter and easier to carve.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are assigned to build a small-scale indoor hydroponic system. Detail the essential components you must assemble to ensure the plant roots receive adequate nutrition and oxygen. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: You must assemble a water reservoir holding the nutrient solution, a submersible water pump to circulate the liquid, an air pump with an airstone to oxygenate the water, and net pots filled with clay pebbles to securely anchor the roots.
